tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the DartzDabz directory of AI agent tools (MCP servers, x402 pay-per-call APIs and agent platforms) by keyword, with optional type and category filters. Returns name, type, category, the latest automated 0-100 trust score (null when not scored) and the DartzDabz page URL. Official vendor MCP

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Get one tool from the DartzDabz directory by its DartzDabz page path or slug (e.g. "mcp/github-official"), its endpoint URL, or its exact name. Returns the endpoint URL, type, trust score, trust and readiness sub-scores, last check time (UTC) and the page URL.

tools.name: get_x402_scores
tools.description: Latest DartzDabz scores for x402 pay-per-call API endpoints from an unpaid, never-signing daily probe: grade, score, latency, HTTP status, price in USD and network. Filter by host or minimum score. Data is CC BY 4.0 (attribute "x402 endpoint scores by DartzDabz").

tools.name: get_directory_counts
tools.description: How many tools DartzDabz tracks (total, by source, scored, robots opted out, pending) and the date of those counts, plus the category list.
